C=/home/jack/.t3/bench-runs/2026-09-29-claude-fable-high/att-010/clone
mkdir -p $W/gen $W/fp1 $W/fp2 && cd $W
sed 's/^!ENCODINGS!$/    utf-8 utf-16/' $C/crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh > $W/gen/_rg
cp $W/gen/_rg $W/fp1/_rg
cp $W/gen/_rg $W/fp2/_ripgrep
echo "=== A: source before compinit (no compdef)"
zsh -f -c "source $W/gen/_rg; echo rc=\$?"
echo "=== A2: source <() before compinit"
zsh -f -c "source <(cat $W/gen/_rg); echo rc=\$?"
echo "=== B: source after compinit"
zsh -f -c "autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -u -d $W/zcd1; source <(cat $W/gen/_rg); echo rc=\$? comps=\$_comps[rg]; whence -w _rg"
echo "=== E: source by relative name _rg after compinit"
zsh -f -c "autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -u -d $W/zcd1; cd $W/gen; source ./_rg; echo rc=\$?; source _rg; echo rc=\$?; path=($W/gen \$path); cd /; source _rg; echo rc3=\$?"
echo "=== test-complete style with compdef defined"
zsh -f -c "autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -u -d $W/zcd1; f() { ( _RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS=1 source \$1 ) }; f $W/gen/_rg | head -3; echo lines=\$(f $W/gen/_rg | wc -l)"
echo "=== test-complete style without compdef"
zsh -f -c "f() { ( _RG_COMPLETE_LIST_ARGS=1 source \$1 ) }; echo lines=\$(f $W/gen/_rg | wc -l)"

W=/home/jack/.t3/bench-runs/2026-09-29-claude-fable-high/att-010/clone-work
cd $W
echo "=== C: autoload as _rg (expect attempt to run _arguments)"
zsh -f -c "fpath=($W/fp1 \$fpath); autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -u -d $W/zcd2; echo comps=\$_comps[rg]; _rg; echo rc=\$?"
echo "=== D: autoload as _ripgrep (file renamed)"
zsh -f -c "fpath=($W/fp2 \$fpath); autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -u -d $W/zcd3; echo comps=\$_comps[rg]; _ripgrep; echo rc=\$?; echo comps_after=\$_comps[rg]"
echo "=== F: aliases at source time"
zsh -f -i -c "autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -u -d $W/zcd1; alias -g file=XXFILE; alias local='typeset -g'; source <(cat $W/gen/_rg); echo rc=\$?; whence -f _rg | grep -n -m3 -E 'XXFILE|typeset -g'" 2>&1 | head
echo "=== F2: autoload -U w/ aliases"
zsh -f -i -c "fpath=($W/fp1 \$fpath); autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -u -d $W/zcd2; alias -g file=XXFILE; alias local='typeset -g'; autoload +X -U _rg 2>/dev/null; whence -f _rg | grep -c -E 'XXFILE|typeset -g'" 2>&1 | head
echo "=== G: real completion through zpty, file named _ripgrep"
cat > $W/zpty_test.zsh <<'EOF'
zmodload zsh/zpty
W=$1; FP=$2
zpty z "zsh -f -i"
zpty -w z "PS1='%% '; fpath=($FP \$fpath); autoload -Uz compinit; compinit -u -d $W/zcd_$3; zstyle ':completion:*' list-prompt ''; "
sleep 1
zpty -r z out1 '*' 2>/dev/null
zpty -w -n z $'rg --generate=complete-z\t'
sleep 2
zpty -r z out2 '*'
print -r -- "FIRST TAB: ${(V)out2}"
zpty -w -n z $'\t'
sleep 2
out3=
zpty -r z out3 '*'
print -r -- "SECOND TAB: ${(V)out3}"
zpty -d z
EOF
zsh -f $W/zpty_test.zsh $W $W/fp1 a 2>&1 | tail -3
zsh -f $W/zpty_test.zsh $W $W/fp2 b 2>&1 | tail -3
